direction: Editorial finance — navy + mint-emerald (QuintEdge-inspired design language, Jun 2026). Warm, human, confident. No violet, no terminal gimmicks (no CRT scanlines, dot-matrix grid, mono ticker, corner-tick panels, sharp 2px corners).
scope: Public landing page only (.landing-dark). Auth-gated app retains the violet dark palette.

typography.headings: Space Grotesk (bold geometric sans, 700, tight -0.03em tracking, clamped magazine scale)
typography.accents: Fraunces (italic serif, tinted mint) for the punchline word only, e.g. 'Financial'
typography.eyebrow: Space Grotesk uppercase caps, 0.16em tracking, mint, with a short leading rule (::before)

colors.primary: #12E29A mint-emerald (var(--color-primary)); all accents folded into this single mint

components.buttons: Pill (.lv-cta): mint fill with dark-navy label (#06231A), clean sans; ghost variant = transparent + mint hover border. border-radius 999px.
components.cards: .lv-panel — soft 16px rounded, calm 1px border, no corner-ticks, hover = border-color shift only (no lift/glow).
components.hero: Centered: mint eyebrow -> bold sans H1 with italic-serif mint accent word -> bold subhead -> muted paragraph -> two pill CTAs -> trust line -> full-width STAT BAND (mint numbers + muted caps labels, drawn only from existing copy facts).
components.navbar: Clean sans links, mint 'Free Mock' + mint dot (no glow), pill sign-up. No terminal market status bar.
components.stat_band: grid 2/3/6 cols, mint bold numbers (Space Grotesk), uppercase muted labels.

motion: Restraint: staggered word fade-in on the H1, gentle CTA lift on hover (transform translateY -1px), sparkline draw. No blobs, no parallax, no blinking cursor.

accessibility.contrast: High contrast on navy. Mint pills always use dark-navy labels, never white.
accessibility.data_testid: Preserve all existing data-testid attributes. Every interactive element MUST have one.

guardrails: DO NOT change landing copy — restyle only.
DO NOT reintroduce violet tokens or terminal gimmicks on the landing.
DO NOT use white text on mint fills — use dark navy (#06231A).
Headlines = bold sans; only the single punchline word is italic serif mint.
Intro sequence supports ?nointro=1 to skip (used for QA screenshots).
